mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code_standard (project_id, name, description, scope, enabled, default_apply, sort_order, archived, source_project_id, source_standard_id, source_version_id, source_version_no, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{scope}, #{enabled}, #{defaultApply}, #{sortOrder}, #{archived}, #{sourceProjectId}, #{sourceStandardId}, #{sourceVersionId}, #{sourceVersionNo}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE code_standard SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, scope = #{scope}, enabled = #{enabled}, default_apply = #{defaultApply}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, archived = #{archived}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND archived = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM code_standard WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY archived, sort_order, id
